errorCodes.meaning: The parent does not list this network — no listing signed by the parent names it with `nodeType` `VTN` under the DTG `lists/1` predicate — so there is nothing to acknowledge.
The network at `url` answers as a DID other than `network`.
A parent role — mapped in `roles`, or required by the parent and left unmapped — would be served by a role this network does not define. `details.role` names the parent role.

The parent could not be reached, refused a registration or the acknowledgement, or answered with an acceptance or grant that does not match what was sent. No membership is recorded. `details.code` and `details.message` carry the parent's error when it gave one.

Credential.description: A DTG credential (W3C VC 2.0, JSON) exactly as signed. Verified by the party relying on it, never by its shape here: it is an open object so a binding cannot narrow away a member the proof covers.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The membership as it now stands.

membership.description: This network's membership of the parent as it now stands.

Response.title: VTN Memberships — Join — response payload

RoleMapping.description: Which of this network's roles serves a parent's role.

localRole.description: This network's role whose network group serves it.

RoleName.description: A role's name: 1–64 lowercase letters, digits, `-` or `_`.

SignedTask.description: A complete Trust Task document, with its proof, exactly as signed and received. Verified as a document in its own right; open so its proof still covers every member, and so its digest can be recomputed.

UpstreamGroup.description: A group this network registered at its parent.

acceptance.description: The parent's groupRegistered credential accepting the registration: issued by the parent, subject this network's network group, `object.digestMultibase` the digest of `registration`, revocable on the parent's status list.

registration.description: This network's signed vtn/groups/register request to the parent.

UpstreamMembership.description: This network's membership of a parent.

listing.description: The parent's listing of this network, as verified.

repudiation.description: This network's repudiation of the listing or grant.

state.description: `acknowledged`: this network is a member. `repudiated`: it rejected the parent's listing. `departed`: it left.

schema.description: Accept a parent network's listing of this network: register this network's groups for the parent's roles, then acknowledge the parent's membership offer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

network.description: The parent network's DID. This network refuses if the network found at `url` answers as another DID.

roles.description: Which of this network's roles serves each parent role. A role the parent requires that is not mapped is served by this network's role of the same name.

url.description: The parent network's base URL, as the parent's administrators gave it. Where it is reached, not who it is.
